role: Expose local codebase indexing, search, retrieval, and drift detection through FastAPI endpoints.

header_fields.ROLE: Expose local codebase indexing, search, retrieval, and drift detection through FastAPI endpoints.
OUTPUTS: search result responses with grounded file and line references
OWNS: request and response DTOs for HTTP routes
HTTP error handling for missing indexes
SIDE_EFFECTS: /index reads repository files and writes a local JSON index
/drift reads repository files and a local JSON index
NOTES: Keep endpoints thin and delegate core behavior to existing modules.
This API exposes grounded context retrieval, not generated answers yet.
Agent and LLM behavior should be added after these deterministic routes are stable.

role: Define deterministic agent node functions for the code question workflow.

header_fields.ROLE: Define deterministic agent node functions for the code question workflow.
NOTES: Keep node behavior deterministic until the graph wiring is ready.
The planner should produce an explainable plan, not a generated answer.
Future nodes should preserve the same state-copying style.

role: Define state models for the future code question agent workflow.

header_fields.ROLE: Define state models for the future code question agent workflow.
NOTES: This slice defines structure only.
Keep the state explicit so the workflow remains explainable.
The future agent should refuse when retrieval or verification says context is insufficient.

role: Retrieve grounded source context from an index snapshot and decide whether it is sufficient.

header_fields.ROLE: Retrieve grounded source context from an index snapshot and decide whether it is sufficient.
OUTPUTS: RetrievalResponse records with sufficiency decisions and grounded SearchResult records
SIDE_EFFECTS: load_and_retrieve_context reads a local JSON index file

reads: local JSON index file when load_and_retrieve_context is used

NOTES: This service does not generate answers.
It decides whether enough grounded context exists for a future answer step.
Keep refusal reasons plain and developer-facing.

role: Provide deterministic local vector-style retrieval over source chunks.

header_fields.ROLE: Provide deterministic local vector-style retrieval over source chunks.
OUTPUTS: SearchResult records ordered by descending relevance score
NOTES: This is a dependency-free retrieval baseline for the MVP.
It gives us testable retrieval behavior before adding ChromaDB.
Later ChromaDB storage should preserve the same public search behavior.

role: Persist and load local index snapshots containing scanned file metadata and source chunks.

header_fields.ROLE: Persist and load local index snapshots containing scanned file metadata and source chunks.
SIDE_EFFECTS: deletes local index file when requested
NOTES: Keep persistence JSON-based for the MVP.
This gives drift detection a stable stored baseline before adding vector search.
Read with utf-8-sig tolerance so a BOM does not break local recovery.

role: Coordinate repository scanning, source chunking, and JSON index snapshot persistence.

header_fields.ROLE: Coordinate repository scanning, source chunking, and JSON index snapshot persistence.
SIDE_EFFECTS: reads repository files through scanner and chunker
writes JSON index snapshot through index store
NOTES: This module wires existing deterministic pieces together.
Keep it small so FastAPI and CLI can call the same indexing behavior later.
Do not add AI behavior here.

role: Scan a local repository and return structured file metadata for supported source files.

header_fields.ROLE: Scan a local repository and return structured file metadata for supported source files.
SIDE_EFFECTS: reads supported source files for hashing
NOTES: Keep scanner behavior deterministic and easy to test.
Prefer repo-relative paths for anything that may be shown to users.
Do not add AI behavior here.

role: Split source text into deterministic chunks while preserving file and line references.

header_fields.ROLE: Split source text into deterministic chunks while preserving file and line references.
OUTPUTS: SourceChunk records with stable chunk IDs and line references
SIDE_EFFECTS: chunk_file reads source files from disk

reads: source files when chunk_file is used

NOTES: Keep this chunker line-based for the MVP.
AST-aware or symbol-aware chunking can be added later if needed.
The key requirement here is grounded references back to file path and line range.

role: Compare indexed file metadata against current file metadata and report stale context.

header_fields.ROLE: Compare indexed file metadata against current file metadata and report stale context.
OUTPUTS: FileDrift records grouped by added, modified, removed, and unchanged files
OWNS: file metadata comparison by relative path
modified file detection using content hashes
NOTES: Content hash differences are treated as stale context.
Modified timestamps are included in results for inspection, but timestamp-only changes do not make content stale.
Relative paths are normalized to forward slashes before comparison.

role: Define local configuration values for the codebase context assistant.

header_fields.ROLE: Define local configuration values for the codebase context assistant.
NOTES: Keep this model small until runtime configuration needs become clearer.
Avoid hiding project behavior behind configuration too early.

role: Define shared data models used by the codebase context assistant.

header_fields.ROLE: Define shared data models used by the codebase context assistant.
OWNS: stable field names used between project modules
NOTES: Models should stay simple and explicit.
Prefer adding fields when a slice actually needs them instead of guessing far ahead.

role: Scan this project, extract architectural headers and code shape, and generate system map outputs.

header_fields.ROLE: Scan this project, extract architectural headers and code shape, and generate system map outputs.
OUTPUTS: header and structure warnings for scanned modules
DOWNSTREAM: future maintenance and re-entry into the codebase
NOTES: This script keeps the project architecture inspectable as the codebase evolves.
It should remain documentation-focused and must not take on runtime assistant logic.
Header placement rule: from __future__ import annotations comes first, then the architecture header.

header_fields.ROLE: Verify drift detection between indexed file metadata and current scanned file metadata.
NOTES: These tests protect the stale-context behavior needed before vector search or agent answers.

deletes temporary JSON index files through pytest tmp_path
